title: lippia spiraeastrum
intro: Lippia spiraeastrum, commonly known as the Mexican prairie balm, is a plant species in the family Verbenaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and skin conditions, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lippia spiraeastrum include soothing and calming effects on the skin and respiratory system, which can help alleviate symptoms of irritation and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily composed of volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
